name: Sygma Catalyst
summary: An Object that fuels the attack and digs Matters from the deck.

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: When the Entity it is assigned to attacks, that Entity gets +1 Power until end of turn. Then roll a d6: on 5–6 look at the top 4 cards of your deck, you may reveal a Matter among them and add it to your hand, and put the others into your Retire Zone.
